headline: Mexican economy would grow 1.9% this year due to export strength: Monex
summary: Monex expects Mexico's economy to grow 1.9% this year, driven by export strength. Demand for machinery and equipment and related investment are cited as supporting factors.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy and a major manufacturing exporter, closely tied to US trade. Growth forecasts shape expectations for peso assets and regional investment.
original_headline: Economía mexicana crecería 1.9% este año por fortaleza exportadora: Monex
